newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Boskalis sees 1997 net up 12-20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Boskalis sees 1997 net up 12-20 percent.

text.p: Dutch dredger Koninklijke Boskalis Westminster NV said on Thursday it expected 1997 net profit to rise by 12-20 percent from 1996's 62.1 million guilders.

"By 'significant', we mean a net profit growth of between 12 and 20 percent," chairman Rob van Gelder told reporters, referring to the company's earlier outlook which said it expected current year net profits to grow significantly.
Van Gelder said that, based on the bright 1997 outlook, the company had maintained its dividend at 1.10 guilders/share, or a 45 percent payout ratio, compared to the usual 30-40 percent.
